messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for customer NewHaven (dedicated pool eu-west1) — p99=2.1s (baseline 0.6s), p95=820ms, error-rate +0.15% — autoscale attempts failing. Pager sent to @ravi_oncall
ravi_oncall: acknowledging. digging in — can someone post the pool ID and noisy tenant list?
leo_sre: pool id redwood-dedicated-eu1-42. I see sustained queue growth on the pool agents, CPU pinned on a subset of GPUs. Kernel mem pressure showing elevated copy stalls.
maria_se: NewHaven reporting user-visible latency increases, customers on chat and embeddings routes. They're on vpc-dedicated with traffic split 80/20 across instances.
zoe_support: I just messaged NewHaven: we're investigating, will update in 15. CS asked for ETA and mitigation options.
ajay_platform: routing telemetry shows a spike concentrated on two tenants: thundra-analytics and sandbox-ingest. thundra traffic cadence jumped at 08:08 UTC.
leo_sre: recommendation: 1) isolate noisy tenant thundra-analytics (move to eviction lane) 2) bump pool by +2 GPUs (hot-add) 3) enable immediate fallback to smaller model-quant (rwd-3b-quant) for non-critical routes. Which do we want first?
ravi_oncall: do isolation first, then scale. maria, can we toggle lightweight model for NewHaven chat route without breaking schema?
maria_se: yes — chat uses freeform text gen. We can flip to rwd-3b-quant for non-authenticated assistant calls. I'll prepare rollout patch (canary 10%).
leo_sre: command to evict tenant (run on control plane):
```
redwoodctl tenant evict --pool redwood-dedicated-eu1-42 --tenant thundra-analytics --reason "noisy-traffic-temp-eviction"
```
deployment-bot: accepted eviction request, starting eviction workflow (step 1/3).
ajay_platform: routing change: shifting 30% of new session openers to eu-west2 as soft failover to ease eu-west1. Will monitor kv-cache miss rate.
zoe_support: CS updated NewHaven: temporary isolation + regional shift in progress; asked if we can reduce concurrency caps — they'd prefer if we avoid evicting named tenants if possible.
ravi_oncall: leo please run eviction now. ajay start the eu-west2 shift. maria start canary of rwd-3b-quant after eviction confirmed. I'll keep NewHaven on the loop.
leo_sre: eviction completed. backend reports thundra-analytics connections draining, CPU pressure down ~18% across affected agents.
ajay_platform: eu-west2 shift in flight — 30% routed, p99 in eu-west1 dropping to 1.1s within 60s. kv-cache miss +3% (expected).
maria_se: canary of rwd-3b-quant at 10% applied to non-critical chat sessions. Early latency shows p99 650ms, quality pass on smoke evals.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 reduced to 0.9s, p95 480ms, error-rate back to baseline. Status: mitigation in progress, monitoring.
zoe_support: NewHaven CS says they're seeing improvements, will hold escalation. Thanks team.
ravi_oncall: we'll wait 15m then decide to scale down the eviction or keep until traffic normalizes. leo, please keep logs for postmortem (KV hit patterns, tenant request profile).
leo_sre: logs and perf dump saved to s3://redwood-incident-logs/8098765432/ — I uploaded a short diagnostic gist: https://internal.redwood/g/8098765432-diagnostics
ajay_platform: queued autoscale +2 GPUs still available if needed, but currently holding.
maria_se: I'll prepare rollback plan for the model canary and a quick quality check list for customers.
deployment-bot: eviction workflow step 3/3 completed, tenant reassign window available.
ravi_oncall: marking as mitigation-success for now. Handing off to follow-up: postmortem + customer RCA. Assigning to @leo_sre and @maria_se. I'll file the incident and follow-up PSR.
zoe_support: I'll coordinate customer comms and summarize timeline.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation in place). Please set incident severity and schedule postmortem within 72h.
